blocks.text: We clean Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, and Saturdays 9am to 1pm.
We serve Balmain, Rozelle, Lilyfield, Birchgrove, and Mort Bay.
Every clean includes vacuuming, mopping, dusting, bathroom and kitchen surfaces, bins emptied, and a final walkthrough check.
Booking takes two minutes: reply with your suburb and preferred day, we confirm by email, and you pay after the clean is done.
Yes, we do commercial and office cleaning, as well as home cleaning and oven cleans.
